caption: The drawing depicts a single textile object resembling a pouch or small bag with a flap. The main body of the pouch is rectangular with a black background and is decorated with a gold diamond lattice pattern; within each diamond there are red shapes resembling flowers or buds with yellow stems, and there is a larger, more elaborate gold and red floral motif in the center. The flap and inner lining of the pouch are depicted in a textured red color and appear to be made of a different material than the exterior. The rim and a strap attached to the pouch are gold or yellowish in color, with the strap lying loosely across the top. The background of the drawing is a plain, light cream or off-white color with no additional objects or details. A signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Wool Pocketbook
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
